name: ezauth
short_description: Multi-tenant authentication service with email signup, magic link sign-in, JWT sessions, JWKS, SSO, and admin dashboard.
long_description: EZAuth is a production-ready, multi-tenant authentication service built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It provides comprehensive email-based authentication (signup with verification, magic link sign-in, password auth), RS256 JWT sessions with refresh token rotation, hashcash proof-of-work anti-abuse, rate limiting, cross-domain SSO, and a full-featured admin dashboard for managing tenants, applications, users, and email templates. The service includes SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Swift, and Kotlin, a command-line client, and comprehensive REST API. Security is built-in with token hashing, Argon2id passwords, atomic token consumption, and per-app CORS configuration.

modules.description: FastAPI application factory with lifespan management and route registration for all API endpoints
Pydantic settings configuration for environment variables and application settings
Cryptographic utilities for token generation, SHA-256 hashing, and constant-time token comparison
Redis-backed rate limiter with per-IP and per-email limits supporting multi-tenant isolation
FastAPI dependency injectors for database sessions, Redis, application resolution, and session authentication
SQLAlchemy async engine configuration and database connection management
SQLAlchemy declarative base model and common model utilities
Core authentication service handling signup, signin, email verification, and token management
Session management service for JWT creation, refresh token rotation, and session revocation
Email delivery service using AWS SES with Mustache template rendering and MIME formatting
Password hashing and verification using Argon2id with automatic parameter upgrades
Proof-of-work challenge generation and validation using Argon2id for signup abuse prevention
Main API router mounting frontend and backend API routes at /v1 prefix
User SQLAlchemy model with email, password hash, and email verification fields
Application model representing tenant sub-applications with JWT configuration and key management
